'''Pepper's Pax''' was a dining establishment located on [[Darlyn Boda/Legends|Darlyn Boda]]. Beings seeking information on local happenings could find it here, though anyone visiting for the first time was required to prove their intestinal fortitude by consuming [[firespice]] vegetable pods. Those unable to pass this test were summarily kicked out.
